description: This is a Java test class named CommandBaseTest, which serves as an abstract base class for testing commands in the Fineract system. It sets up a test environment using Testcontainers to run a PostgreSQL database, and it utilizes Spring Boot testing annotations and dependency injection to prepare required components such as CommandRepository and CommandMapper.

classes.name: CommandBaseTest
classes.description: An abstract base class for command-related tests in Fineract, setting up a PostgreSQL container and configuring Spring Boot test context.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: A static method annotated with @DynamicPropertySource to configure the Spring environment with the PostgreSQL test container's connection details.
